about.heading: Engineering Philosophy & Background
about.bio1: I am a Full-Stack Software Engineer focused on architecting resilient, high-performance web systems. My work bridges reactive client-side state and offline persistence with robust, asynchronous distributed backend infrastructure across TypeScript and Python.
about.bio2: Dedicated to clean design patterns, strict type safety, and modular scalability (Feature-Sliced Design), I engineer software with sub-millisecond query performance, decoupled APIs (Django Ninja + Celery), and automated DX toolchains. I am actively seeking Full-Time Full-Stack / Software Engineering roles.

dualEngineContent.title: Dual-Engine Local-First Persistence & Reactivity (InterviewFlow Engine)
dualEngineContent.summary: Combining the raw speed of in-memory reactive state with the bulletproof persistence of embedded SQLite.
dualEngineContent.p1: TanStack DB provides sub-millisecond (< 1ms) in-memory queries and optimistic draft mutations directly in the client layer, ensuring zero UI evaluation lag during interviews.
dualEngineContent.p2: PowerSync manages background WAL (Write-Ahead Logging) streaming and client-side wa-sqlite (WebAssembly SQLite) storage, ensuring zero session data loss during complete network disconnects.

fsdContent.title: Feature-Sliced Design (FSD v2.1) Architecture
fsdContent.summary: Strict layer separation that scales codebases without spaghetti coupling.
fsdContent.p1: Structured into App → Pages → Widgets → Features → Entities → Shared layers. High layers may only import from lower layers.
fsdContent.p2: Automated layer boundary verification using Steiger linter, guaranteeing that business logic remains decoupled and easily testable.

backendContent.title: Decoupled Typed REST + Multi-Lane Async Workers (AWS Infrastructure)
backendContent.summary: Fast, type-safe API endpoints powered by Django Ninja and distributed background tasks.
backendContent.p1: Django Ninja provides end-to-end type safety, auto-generated OpenAPI documentation, and headless cookie session authentication with strict CSRF protection.
backendContent.p2: Celery multi-lane worker pipelines with Redis message brokers manage transactional email dispatching (AWS SES), PDF assessment synthesis, and async webhook sync.

perfContent.title: Engineering Standards, Benchmarks & DX Tooling
perfContent.summary: Blazing fast toolchains, sub-second builds, and deep static codebase intelligence.
perfContent.p1: Modern DX powered by Bun (package manager & test runner), uv & Ruff (Python speed toolchains), and automated lint gates.
perfContent.p2: Code quality enforced with React Doctor (React 19 compiler compliance), Fallow (dead code & duplication analysis), and Playwright E2E suites.
